text: Centralized and opaque reputation systems such as China's Social Credit System are unstable in the long run and particularly dangerous, because their computerized bureaucracy makes them inherently rigid and their early successes make them progressively more brittle.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Future of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782201
